puzzle.hint: This powerful opening verse of Surah Al-Hadid (The Iron) proclaims that all of creation declares Allah's perfection, highlighting His two majestic attributes of Supreme Might and Infinite Wisdom.
puzzle.arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
puzzle.verseEn: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
